courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的水利與海岸設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring water and coastal works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 壩基排水廊道
related.transfer: 可遷移「冷卻收縮與接縫開度」與「填充層的法向柔度」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；壩基排水廊道的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Cooling contraction and joint aperture" and "Normal compliance of the filled layer" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Dam-foundation drainage galleries must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦接縫封拱、灌漿體積與荷載傳遞驗證；壩基排水廊道則以排水廊道的揚壓控制、量測分區與性能退化為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on joint closure grouting, volume accounting and load-transfer verification; Dam-foundation drainage galleries centres on gallery uplift control, monitoring zones and performance degradation, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「冷卻收縮與接縫開度」與「水力阻力與廊道水頭」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到壩基排水廊道，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「廊道熱量與通風尺度」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Cooling contraction and joint aperture” and “Hydraulic resistance and gallery head”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Dam-foundation drainage galleries, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Gallery heat and ventilation scale", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 大壩施工導流

related.difference: 本課聚焦接縫封拱、灌漿體積與荷載傳遞驗證；大壩施工導流則以施工導流的洪水暴露、過流能力與階段轉換為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on joint closure grouting, volume accounting and load-transfer verification; River diversion during dam construction centres on diversion flood exposure, hydraulic capacity and construction transitions, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「冷卻收縮與接縫開度」與「施工期洪水暴露」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到大壩施工導流，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「截流缺口的流速放大」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Cooling contraction and joint aperture” and “Construction-period flood exposure”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to River diversion during dam construction, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Closure-gap velocity amplification", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 大壩接縫灌漿
history.text: 壩體接縫灌漿把分開澆築的混凝土塊連成預定傳力系統，結構封拱與既有止水修復是不同目的，課程將兩者證據分開並比較水力與力學性能。重力壩設計專書出版，提供混凝土分塊與接縫背景。 工兵團拱壩設計手冊出版，提供封拱與三維傳力背景。 工兵團灌漿技術手冊出版，作材料與驗證方法參照。這些年份是技術出版節點，不代表某座壩的施工年表。課程從公開工法建立原創算例，地標僅用於對照不同壩型與環境；每項材料參數、荷載和允許條件仍需依工程調查與專案設計重新確定。
history.textEn: Dam-joint grouting connects separately placed blocks into an intended load-transfer system. Structural closure and repair of existing waterstops have different purposes; this course separates their evidence while comparing hydraulic and mechanical performance. Gravity-dam design guidance is published, providing context for concrete blocks and joints. USACE arch-dam guidance is published, supporting closure and three-dimensional load-transfer context. USACE Grouting Technology is published as a reference for materials and verification methods. These years mark technical publications rather than construction events at a particular dam. The course develops original calculations from public engineering principles. Landmarks compare dam types and settings; material parameters, loads and admissible conditions still require project investigations and specific design. The examples do not assert that an unverified technique was used at a named structure.

history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「冷卻收縮與接縫開度」到「波速檢測與接觸證據」改寫為 40 個原創分析、試驗與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿、設計圖或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Cooling contraction and joint aperture" through "Wave velocity and contact evidence" into 40 original analysis, testing and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts, drawings or field procedures.
